tools.name: command_list
tools.description: List every command (id, label, menu path, shortcut, parameter doc, enabled now). Menus, shortcuts, panels and timeline gestures all map to these ids.

enabled_only.description: Only commands that can run right now.

filter.description: Only commands whose id or label contains this text (case-insensitive).

tools.name: command_run
tools.description: Run a command by id with JSON params, e.g. {"id":"timeline.razor","params":{"seconds":3.5}} or {"id":"effects.apply","params":{"effect":"Gaussian Blur"}}. Undoable edits land in History.

tools.name: media_import
tools.description: Import media files by absolute path (MP4/MOV, WAV/MP3/FLAC/AIFF/Ogg, PNG/JPEG/…).

tools.name: project_inspect
tools.description: Project tree (bins and items with ids, types, durations), active sequence, source clip.

tools.name: render_frame
tools.description: Render the active sequence's frame (at `seconds` or the playhead) and return it as PNG.

seconds.description: Timeline time in seconds (default: the playhead).

tools.name: sequence_inspect
tools.description: The active sequence as JSON: settings, tracks, clips (ids, start/duration in ticks and frames, effects), transitions, markers, in/out, playhead, selection. 254016000000 ticks = 1 second.

tools.name: ui_click
tools.description: Live app: click an element by id or at x,y (points). Supports right/middle button, double-click (count=2) and modifiers.

tools.name: ui_control
tools.description: Live app: call any control-channel method directly (ui.set, ui.scroll, ui.timeline.hit, ui.timeline.locate, ui.playback, ui.panel.show, ui.menu.list, …).

tools.name: ui_drag
tools.description: Live app: press-drag-release from one point/element to another (move clips, trim edges, scrub, resize panels, drop project items onto tracks).

from.description: Start: {"id":..} or {"x":..,"y":..} (optionally "fx"/"fy" fractions inside the element).

tools.name: ui_elements
tools.description: Live app: every on-screen interactive element with id, label and rect (points). Use ids with ui_click/ui_drag.

prefix.description: Only element ids starting with this prefix (e.g. `timeline.clip.`).

tools.name: ui_inspect
tools.description: Live app: UI state (tool, workspace, panels, timeline zoom, playback, selection, fps).

tools.name: ui_key
tools.description: Live app: press a key or shortcut (e.g. `Space`, `L`, `Cmd+K`, `Shift+Delete`, `Cmd+Z`).

tools.name: ui_screenshot
tools.description: Live app: screenshot of the window or one panel (PNG).

panel.description: Panel to crop to (e.g. `Timeline`, `Program`); omit for the whole window.

tools.name: ui_type
tools.description: Live app: type text into the focused field.
